implementation_summary: Live-Ollama (0.30.8) placement research over qwen3, qwen2, llama, gemma3 and qwen35. Decision: note=trailing-user, summary=user, no family exceptions. Placement data exported as CONTEXT_PLACEMENT (+ NOTE_PLACEMENTS, SUMMARY_PLACEMENTS enums) in shared/context-usage.ts; unit test parses the document's Decision table and asserts equality. Overflow: Ollama reports prompt_eval_count = num_ctx-1 when the prompt does not fit.
manual_validation: MV-1 (owner Markus): Findings reflect Ollama 0.30.8 on host.lima.internal; raw probe output kept in the session scratchpad, not the repo

retrospective.harder_than_needed: AC-RES-1 presumes OLLAMA_DEBUG runner logs, but the Ollama host (and its logs) is outside the VM, so rendering and cache reuse had to be reconstructed from /api/show templates, raw-generate token-count equality and prompt_eval_duration ratios.
retrospective.surprised_by: Ollama's collate/.System handling silently hoists every trailing system message into the first system block for qwen/llama templates (cache lost every call, llama also loses its generation header); qwen35/gemma4 use compiled renderers with template '{{ .Prompt }}' that cannot be inspected through the API.

caveats: VQ-S3-011 PARTIAL: numeric claims not re-run live by the examiner (Ollama unreachable from examiner sandbox); covered by MV-1
VQ-S3-013 PARTIAL: collate semantics are an S4 implementation obligation; gemma4/gpt-oss unprobed
